$comment: schema_version 0.x (v0, not frozen); tracks design/spec/features/NF-055-057-058-supply-chain.md. Standalone additive/optional fragment. A signed dataset provenance card feeds the CycloneDX AI-BOM (NF-056) and the SLSA-for-ML attestation (NF-057); it is referenced from a capsule/registry via extensions/. Does not modify run-capsule.schema.json.
title: DatasetProvenanceCard
description: Additive/optional — v0, not frozen. A signed dataset provenance card (NF-058): source, version, content hash, transform history, license, and a signature. Each transformHistory entry references an ADR-0090/0109 signed operation content-hash that produced a derivation. Bound to content-addressed registry/capsule digests. MUST NOT contain secrets, raw prompts, or cell values (I-4) — only op digests/types.

source.description: Where the dataset was retrieved from and when.

hash.description: Content hash(es) of the dataset. At minimum a sha256 digest.

license.description: SPDX license identifier or license string, e.g. 'CC-BY-4.0'.

transformHistory.description: Ordered derivation operations. Each references a signed operation digest (ADR-0090/0109) — never raw values (NF-058 req 9).

boundTo.description: Content-addressed registry/capsule digests this card binds to (NF-058 req 9).

signature.description: Signature over the canonical-JSON card body. An unsigned card is not evidence (NF-058).

extensions.description: Vendor extensions. Keys must be reverse-DNS-prefixed.

ContentHash.description: SHA-256 content hash in sha256:<hex> form.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 digest (in-toto DigestSet form, bare hex).

uri.description: Source URI, e.g. 'oci://…/gaia:2026-05'. Configurable to a private endpoint; never a hardcoded external default.

signedOpDigest.description: Content hash of the ADR-0090/0109 signed transform facet that produced this derivation.

producedEdge.description: Reference to the lineage edge produced, e.g. 'lineage:edge:01HX…'. Metadata only — no raw values.

registryDigest.description: Content-addressed registry digest this card is bound to.

capsuleDigest.description: Optional content-addressed capsule digest this card is bound to.

keyid.description: Signer key identifier; defaults to NovaSeal key material, e.g. 'novaseal:2026-07' (ADR-0041/0089).

alg.description: Signature algorithm. Reuses the NovaSeal/Evidence-Bundle Ed25519 path.

sig.description: Base64-encoded signature over the canonical-JSON card body excluding this block.

x-novafabric.governed_by: NF-058 (signed dataset provenance cards); companion NF-055 model signing, NF-057 SLSA-for-ML
x-novafabric.adr: ADR-0105 (AI supply-chain BOM); extends v0.1 Asset Registry + v0.4 Lineage + v0.8 nova promote; relates to ADR-0097, ADR-0090, ADR-0041/0089, ADR-0031, ADR-0024
x-novafabric.secrets_boundary: op digests/types + content-addressed registry digests only; NEVER secrets, raw prompts, or cell values (I-4)
